comment: Mistral AI's Shieldstral 1.0 3B safety classifier (base model mistralai/Ministral-3-3B-Base-2512), the transformers-format checkpoint (Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration; the Mistral-format consolidated.safetensors is not read). SHA-256 of every snapshot file the harness reads (model.safetensors, tokenizer.json and tekken.json equal the Hub's LFS hashes at this revision), pinned 2026-11-06. The license is confirmed upstream: the model card's front matter gives `license: apache-2.0` and its License section says 'This model is licensed under the Apache 2.0 License', adding 'You must not use this model in a manner that infringes, misappropriates, or otherwise violates any third party's rights, including intellectual property rights.' The repository ships no LICENSE file, so the Apache-2.0 text is the Apache Software Foundation's canonical one, checked in under terms/. The network code is transformers' Ministral3Model at the version Forge/uv.lock pins; tekken.json is read only by the optional mistral-common cross-check.
